# LeakSanitizer suppressions for the srt-transport ASan/LSan CI job.
#
# monoio::driver::uring::IoUringDriver::new (monoio 0.2.4, "sync" feature)
# Box::leak()s a couple of small fixed-size allocations (a Timespec, and an
# eventfd read buffer) by design -- they are meant to live for the whole
# process in a real long-running application that builds one runtime and
# keeps it forever. srt-transport's own unit tests (S05: the completion-
# runtime cancellation/budget regressions in runtimes/monoio.rs) construct
# and drop a short-lived monoio Runtime per test, which trips LeakSanitizer
# on monoio's own intentional leak. This is monoio's design choice, not a
# leak in srt-transport's code.
leak:monoio::driver::uring::IoUringDriver
